tools.name: create-calendar
tools.description: Build a standalone iCalendar (.ics) calendar with metadata only — name, description, method (PUBLISH/REQUEST/...), timezone, url, prodId, scale, ttl, source. Returns the full RFC 5545 VCALENDAR text. Use for calendar feed skeletons or shared calendar properties; for calendars with events use the create-*-event tools.

tools.name: create-event
tools.description: Create a calendar containing ONE timed or all-day event and return the complete .ics text. Params: summary, start (required, ISO 8601), end (defaults to start+1h), allDay, floating, timezone, description, location, url, status (CONFIRMED/TENTATIVE/CANCELLED), priority (0-9), organizer {name,email}, attendees [{name,email,role,status,rsvp,type}], categories[], alarms[] (type + triggerBefore/AfterMinutes + repeat), custom X-properties.

tools.name: create-all-day-event
tools.description: Create a calendar containing ONE all-day (multi-day) event from date-only strings and return the complete .ics text. Params: summary, startDate (YYYY-MM-DD, required, inclusive), endDate (YYYY-MM-DD, EXCLUSIVE — the day after the event), timezone, description, location, url, status, categories. Emits DTSTART;VALUE=DATE / DTEND;VALUE=DATE. Ideal for holidays, birthdays, deadlines, trips.

tools.name: create-recurring-event
tools.description: Create a calendar containing ONE recurring event and return the complete .ics text with an RRULE. Params: summary, start (required), end, freq (required: SECONDLY/MINUTELY/HOURLY/DAILY/WEEKLY/MONTHLY/YEARLY), interval, count, until, byDay (SU..SA), byMonth (1-12), byMonthDay (-31..31), bySetPos, startOfWeek, allDay, timezone, description, location, url. Ideal for weekly meetings, monthly reports, daily standups.
